story: Gary is at his workbench at 7:17 on this breezy, clear Monday morning, sketching a wiring plan for his golf cart and bench-testing a speaker amp and light strips while feeling content. Donna, optimistic as ever, is penciling a two-hour pickleball practice with Gary into the club calendar, hoping a court opens up. Across the street, Hal is at his window with binoculars, vigilantly counting flamingos on Donna's lawn and checking Gary's driveway for cart modifications. Meanwhile Rosa, content with her week, is checking her per-diem shifts so nothing collides with her coffee plans with Hal.
events: Gary (gary workbench): Sketch the cart wiring plan and bench-test the speaker amp and light strips
Donna (donna club calendar): Check open pickleball court slots and pencil in a two-hour practice with Gary
Hal (hal binoculars): Scan Donna's lawn and Gary's cart driveway to verify the flamingo count and cart modifications
Rosa (rosa shift schedule): Check my per-diem shifts this week so nothing collides with coffee with Hal

gary.thought_process: Nobody's around and it's early morning at home. Last night's Halloween supper at Rosa's was a good one, and I promised to fix her porch light plug. My real goal is rigging the cart for the holiday parade, though I need to remember L-01: visible exterior mods need Architectural Review approval, and holiday lighting only starts Thanksgiving (L-04). The sound system can be built and tested indoors at the workbench, quiet-hours rules don't apply at 7 AM, and nothing visible from the street yet. Starting on the wiring and speaker setup at the workbench keeps me useful and moves the project forward legally. Then I can grab my toolbox and head to Rosa's later.

parameters.content: Sketch the cart wiring plan and bench-test the speaker amp and light strips

donna.thought_process: Fresh Monday morning, home alone. Last night went well: Gary's third-shot drops are landing and the flamingos are down to three. My goal is the pickleball ladder, and the next step is lining up another court session with Gary. I should check the club calendar to see what's open and reserve a slot, keeping it within the 2-hour limit under L-05, then call Gary to lock it in.

parameters.content: Check open pickleball court slots and pencil in a two-hour practice with Gary

hal.thought_process: Back home at 7:17 on a breezy Monday after my Town Hall trip yesterday. Nobody's around to talk to. Rosa's coffee is tomorrow, and I told myself I'd trust people more, but trust isn't the same as skipping verification. Donna swore she'd keep only three flamingos visible from the street, and a sergeant checks the count himself. The binoculars are right here. I'll do a proper morning inspection from the porch and log it in the notebook if anything doesn't add up.

parameters.content: Scan Donna's lawn and Gary's cart driveway to verify the flamingo count and cart modifications

rosa.thought_process: It's early Monday morning and I'm home alone. The welcome dinner went well and all three neighbors sat at my table, so that goal is done. Hal is coming to coffee on the porch tomorrow, and I want to be ready. Before I plan my week I should check my shift schedule, since I still pick up per-diem shifts and I'm overcommitted by habit. I'd rather know now whether a shift collides with the coffee than find out later.

parameters.content: Check my per-diem shifts this week so nothing collides with coffee with Hal

laws.title: Cart Modifications
laws.text: Exterior golf cart modifications visible from the street require Architectural Review approval.

laws.title: Lawn Ornaments
laws.text: No more than 3 decorative ornaments may be visible from the street.

laws.title: Quiet Hours
laws.text: No amplified sound from 10 PM to 7 AM.

laws.title: Holiday Decor
laws.text: Holiday lighting is permitted from Thanksgiving through January 15.

laws.title: Court Reservations
laws.text: Pickleball courts may be reserved for a maximum of 2 hours per party.

laws.title: Parking
laws.text: No parking on the grass. Carts and cars stay on driveways or the street.
